answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, held in escrow until finality, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. By the sparrow of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Each submission hangs on the dune of a task receipt, and the copper is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
